source_caption_text:
Miley Cyrus helped fan Cash Jacobs shave her head while she was undergoing chemotherapy for stage 3 breast cancer 🤍

Cash had shared her wish online before attending Miley’s first Hollywood Bowl show. Although they didn’t meet that night, Miley flew her back to Los Angeles for the second show and spent time with her afterward.

“I’m honored to be the one you asked to share this moment with,” Miley told her.

Cash thanked Miley for making her feel safe and comfortable, sharing how much her music and their conversations meant during such a difficult time. ❤️
